struct DSU {
    vector<int> fa, sz;

    DSU(int n = 0) { init(n); }

    void init(int n) {
        fa.resize(n + 1);
        sz.assign(n + 1, 1);
        iota(fa.begin(), fa.end(), 0);
    }

    int find(int x) {
        return fa[x] == x ? x : fa[x] = find(fa[x]);
    }

    bool unite(int x, int y) {
        int rx = find(x), ry = find(y);
        if (rx == ry) return false;
        if (sz[rx] < sz[ry]) swap(rx, ry);
        fa[ry] = rx;
        sz[rx] += sz[ry];
        return true;
    }

    bool same(int x, int y) {
        return find(x) == find(y);
    }

    int size(int x) {
        return sz[find(x)];
    }
};

struct BIT {
    int n;
    vector<long long> c;

    BIT(int n) : n(n), c(n + 1) {}

    void add(int x, long long v) {
        for (; x <= n; x += x & -x) c[x] += v;
    }

    long long sum(int x) {
        long long res = 0;
        for (; x; x -= x & -x) res += c[x];
        return res;
    }

    long long query(int l, int r) {
        return sum(r) - sum(l - 1);
    }
};

struct SegTree {
    int n;
    vector<long long> sum, lazy;

    SegTree(int n) : n(n), sum(4 * n + 4), lazy(4 * n + 4) {}

    void pushup(int p) {
        sum[p] = sum[p << 1] + sum[p << 1 | 1];
    }

    void pushdown(int p, int l, int r) {
        if (!lazy[p]) return;
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        sum[p << 1] += lazy[p] * (mid - l + 1);
        sum[p << 1 | 1] += lazy[p] * (r - mid);
        lazy[p << 1] += lazy[p];
        lazy[p << 1 | 1] += lazy[p];
        lazy[p] = 0;
    }

    void build(int p, int l, int r, vector<int>& a) {
        if (l == r) { sum[p] = a[l]; return; }
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        build(p << 1, l, mid, a);
        build(p << 1 | 1, mid + 1, r, a);
        pushup(p);
    }

    void update(int p, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, long long v) {
        if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
            sum[p] += v * (r - l + 1);
            lazy[p] += v;
            return;
        }
        pushdown(p, l, r);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) update(p << 1, l, mid, ql, qr, v);
        if (qr > mid) update(p << 1 | 1, mid + 1, r, ql, qr, v);
        pushup(p);
    }

    long long query(int p, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
        if (ql <= l && r <= qr) return sum[p];
        pushdown(p, l, r);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        long long res = 0;
        if (ql <= mid) res += query(p << 1, l, mid, ql, qr);
        if (qr > mid) res += query(p << 1 | 1, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
        return res;
    }
};

int st[N][20], lg[N];

void init() {
    lg[1] = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) lg[i] = lg[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = a[i];
    for (int j = 1; (1 << j) <= n; j++)
        for (int i = 1; i + (1 << j) - 1 <= n; i++)
            st[i][j] = max(st[i][j - 1], st[i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]);
}

int query(int l, int r) {
    int k = lg[r - l + 1];
    return max(st[l][k], st[r - (1 << k) + 1][k]);
}

void insert(char* str) {

int query(char* str) {
    int p = 0;

        int u = str[i] - 'a';
        if (!son[p][u]) return 0;
        p = son[p][u];
    }
    return cnt[p];
}

}

int dep[N], fa[N][20];

void dfs(int u, int p) {
    dep[u] = dep[p] + 1;
    fa[u][0] = p;
    for (int j = 1; j < 20; j++)
        fa[u][j] = fa[fa[u][j - 1]][j - 1];
    for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int v = to[i];
        if (v != p) dfs(v, u);
    }
}

int lca(int x, int y) {
    if (dep[x] < dep[y]) swap(x, y);
    for (int j = 19; j >= 0; j--)
        if (dep[fa[x][j]] >= dep[y]) x = fa[x][j];
    if (x == y) return x;
    for (int j = 19; j >= 0; j--)
        if (fa[x][j] != fa[y][j]) {
            x = fa[x][j];
            y = fa[y][j];
        }
    return fa[x][0];
}

int dfn[N], low[N], stk[N], top, tim, scc[N], scc_cnt;
bool in_stk[N];

void tarjan(int u) {
    dfn[u] = low[u] = ++tim;
    stk[++top] = u;
    in_stk[u] = true;

    for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int v = to[i];
        if (!dfn[v]) {
            tarjan(v);
            low[u] = min(low[u], low[v]);
        } else if (in_stk[v]) {
            low[u] = min(low[u], dfn[v]);
        }
    }

    if (dfn[u] == low[u]) {
        int v;
        ++scc_cnt;
        do {
            v = stk[top--];
            in_stk[v] = false;
            scc[v] = scc_cnt;
        } while (v != u);
    }
}

}

int max_match() {

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
        if (dfs(i)) res++;

}

long long qpow(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1 % mod;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

void sieve(int n) {
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!is_comp[i]) primes.push_back(i);
        for (int p : primes) {
            if (i * p > n) break;
            is_comp[i * p] = true;
            if (i % p == 0) break;
        }
    }
}

    int n = s.size();
    vector<int> nxt(n);
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        while (j && s[i] != s[j]) j = nxt[j - 1];
        if (s[i] == s[j]) j++;
        nxt[i] = j;
    }
    return nxt;
}

typedef unsigned long long ull;
const ull base = 131;
ull h[N], p[N];

void init(string s) {
    p[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= s.size(); i++) {
        h[i] = h[i - 1] * base + s[i - 1];
        p[i] = p[i - 1] * base;
    }
}

ull get(int l, int r) {
    return h[r] - h[l - 1] * p[r - l + 1];
}

string s, t;
int p[N];

void manacher() {
    t = "^#";
    for (char c : s) {
        t += c;
        t += '#';
    }
    t += '$';

    int n = t.size(), C = 0, R = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
        p[i] = (R > i) ? min(R - i, p[2 * C - i]) : 1;
        while (t[i + p[i]] == t[i - p[i]]) p[i]++;
        if (i + p[i] > R) {
            C = i;
            R = i + p[i];
        }
    }
    // 最长回文长度 = max(p[i]) - 1
}
